title: Gema Nyang Troh Bak Tahta .
intro: Sidroe tokoh nyang beuban jijak toe ngon kursi keadilan, su awaknyan geumeu-ulang-ulang kon ngon teumakot tapi ngon harapan. Peukara nyan nakeuh pribadi, namun resolusi jih akan meugema lam watee, membongkar tradisi nyang menindas. Soe jiwa nyoe nyang keluhan jih jideungo di luwa bintang?
clues: Ulôn teuka deungon até nyang brat, lôn mita keuadelan lam saboh peukara nyang meuikat lidah lôn.
Rayuan ulôn kon keu sidroe utusan mantong; nyan jiék u luwa, ubak Gobnyan nyang deungoe banmandum.
Tutoe haba nyang jipeugah ateueh ulôn lagée rante masa jameun nyang ka lheueh.
Lon peugah haba dan lon peugah haba, deungon ie mata dan deungon logika, keu martabat lon.
Saboh wahyu jitron, jipeuseungap cara-cara jameun dan jiakui rasa sakét ulôn.
Awaknyan jikheun ulôn ureuëng nyang meudakwa keuhai lakoe ulôn, dan nan ulôn jeuet keu sinonim ngon bab nyang peubeubaih ulôn.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Inong Nyang Meudakwa Teuntang Lakoe Geuh (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
identity.answer: Inong Nyang Meudakwa Teuntang Lakoe Geuh (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: Sidang atawa Peuristiwa .
options: Gobnyan mandul dan rindu that keu aneuëk .
Gobnyan geuhadapi adat meucerai nyang menindas .
Gobnyan sidroe ratu nyang teungoh meurunding ngon sidroe nabi .
Gobnyan geupeusom aneuk gobnyan nibak sidroe tiran .
trial.answer: Gobnyan geuhadapi adat meucerai nyang menindas .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Gobnyan geubri beureukat sidroe aneuk bak masa tuha .
Gobnyan meuteumé wahyu ilahi nyang geupeugadoh adat nyan .
Gobnyan jeuet keu ratu lheueh tes .
Gobnyan geubri sidroe aneuëk agam nyang jeuet keu nabi .
outcome.answer: Gobnyan meuteumé wahyu ilahi nyang geupeugadoh adat nyan .

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
